title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
taper: DAT from "3 Decades of Dead" Tree
source: SBD > Reel(0) > DAT > Mac (via Lucid PCI24) > CD-R

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality soundboard capture of a classic ’70s show with standout Dark Star, St. Stephen and Turn On Your Lovelight jams.
ai_review.review: The tape, likely sourced from Marty Weinberg’s board, offers solid overall clarity with the second set sounding especially vivid. Fans rave about the extended Dark Star > St. Stephen > Darkness sequence, the soaring Love‑Light jam and the gentle beauty of Morning Dew and Easy Wind, making this a must‑listen performance despite a modest first‑set sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Enthusiastic 5‑star review highlights an excellent musical performance and generally good board sound; only one detailed source limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall okay sound, first set a bit rough due to equipment trouble, but from Dark Star onward the board recording is clear and vivid with audience ambience audible.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Classic early‑70s set‑list that builds nicely; the second set is highlighted as a “must‑have” with extended jams and strong audience interaction.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s rhythm/solo work is praised as a great prelude to the jam-heavy second set.
